notes: Runtime images: there is no candidate image. The lower agent runs the frozen product from the host venv deeptutor-task-env-v1 (env/build-host.sh: pinned CPython 3.12.13 and requirements.lock) inside bubblewrap; the Builder runs in the builder-codex image that setup builds from this repository. A fresh setup builds only builder-codex.
Release change: the prior-product guard accepts an explicit fresh_install guard with no prior runs or products (a new installation has dispatched none); it blocks nothing in that case.

Release change (2026-10-09): agentloop/lower_transport.py records a relay error that happened after the broker's whole response was read as phase reply_write (with the upstream status and bytes), and agentloop/lower_agent_entry.py tolerates such Candidate reply disconnects (BrokenPipe/ConnectionReset, upstream 200) when the product exited by itself under a valid transport preflight, no other relay or broker event failed, and the broker ledger records every request of the case context completed; the tolerated events are recorded as candidate_reply_disconnect. Anything else stays evaluator_infrastructure_error; the deadline path is unchanged and never read relay events.

Release change (2026-10-10): Docker 29 removes an exited or stopped --rm container asynchronously: for several seconds `docker inspect` still shows it and `docker rm -f` answers "removal of container ... is already in progress" (exit 1); Docker 24 has removed it by then. harbor/formal_one_stop.py BrokerProcess.stop: when the stopped --rm broker's removal outlasts the client's 10 s wait, rm answers "already in progress"; stop now records that and waits up to 30 s for the container to be gone before deciding absent_after_cleanup. Any other rm refusal is judged as before, and a container still present after the wait is not absent. Seen with Docker 29.2.1.
